page.layout: One printed title page. Above the centre, small faint lines at the head; in the centre, the large title "De Lingua Hebraica" with "et" and "De Lingua Chaldaica" below; a printer's device or ornament in the lower middle; the imprint in small type at the foot. Stamps and the red and orange marks on the scan are not printed text.
page.notes: The title page is very faded. Only the large words "De Lingua Hebraica", "et" and "De Lingua Chaldaica" can be made out with some confidence; the last is doubtful. The author's name and the lines above it are not legible. The lines at the foot, which hold the imprint (place, printer and date), cannot be read. A decorative device or ornament sits between the title and the imprint. Coloured stamps and marks on the scan are not transcribed.
